interface.longDescription: Health-first evidence-gated Promkes production with canonical MCG, seven single-owner Guides, quantified motion, optional renderer-neutral Remotion motion patterns and independent QA. V2 adds universal handoff validation, externally rooted trust controls, domain procedures and the S10 two-lane contract.
defaultPrompt: Ubah poster/infografis, caption, audio/transkrip, naskah atau kombinasi sumber Promkes menjadi paket produksi explainer yang dapat ditelusuri dari sumber sampai QA.
Sebelum audit percakapan, upgrade, rekonsiliasi source tree, publikasi GitHub atau keputusan rilis, M00 wajib menerapkan preflight S14 dan menyatakan batas cakupan konteks.
Pisahkan instruksi eksplisit, preferensi, inferensi, usulan, unknown dan keputusan superseded. Konteks percakapan bukan bukti klinis, hak, persetujuan atau hasil tes.
Jaga spesifikasi desain statis dan kampanye tetap project-scoped; distribusi sosial bersifat opsional dan tidak menjanjikan reach/viral/FYP.
Jangan klaim engine parity, host runtime, AI/ASR, Remotion render, MP4 QA, lisensi atau persetujuan manusia tanpa bukti.
Bedakan suite acceptance privat 20 kasus dari suite GitHub 45 kasus; namespace-kan ID dan jangan gunakan ringkasan pytest untuk menutup kasus acceptance.
Pertahankan NOT_RUN pada setiap kasus tanpa eksekusi dan oracle bukti yang spesifik.
S02 is the sole authority for interpreting health claims and Fact Lock; formula reuse never transfers clinical approval to another project.
S14 mandatory cross-cutting preflight remains required for every version audit, source reconciliation, publication and release decision.
Preserve conservative R0/R1/R2/R3 routing: highest credible trigger wins, UNKNOWN material risk is at least R2, critical triggers force R3, and R2/R3 are never fast-tracked.
Use only APPROVED, rights-cleared, scope-matched Approved Formula Ledger records with provenance, exact model/version, tests and independent S12 QA.
Model drift creates an immutable review candidate; never auto-approve a capability or advance a human-accepted baseline after a hash change.
S08 model selection advice is non-authoritative and candidate-only; exact provider/model/version features require evidence, and the user/project owner remains the selector.
Project outcome records may contain privacy-minimized process metrics only; do not collect new audience/patient behavioral-health data or infer clinical effects.
Preserve traceability from approved source/claim through beat, scene/shot, motion, renderer layer and independent QA oracle; HOLD/NOT_RUN/NOT_VERIFIED/BLOCKED remain distinct.

Before validating or using AFL/MDS/MSA/POR/RPF records, follow skills/video-explainer-promkes/references/learning-governance-execution-v4.1.10.md and run the schema/semantic validator. A validator PASS never replaces S02, S12, S14 or human authority.
M00 must load skills/video-explainer-promkes/references/v2-enforcement-overlay.md for every project using V2 enforcement.
Every M00–S14 producer/receiver handoff must conform to schemas/v4/handoff-envelope.schema.json and pass both structural and semantic validation through scripts/promkes_v2/handoff.py.
Before dispatching S02, S03, S04, S05, S06, S07 or S13, load that skill folder’s references/v2-operational-protocol.md and preserve its sole domain ownership.

S10 is one identity with internal lanes S10-MP (Media Production) and S10-RE (Renderer Engineering); retain renderer-code-engineering as the existing private S10-RE slug alias. Do not add a second S10 skill.
FND-001 through FND-009 are addressed by the V2 enforcement modules; external trust roots, approver roles, artifact index and resource ceilings must be provisioned outside project payloads.

Keep the V2 44-case acceptance suite distinct from historical private and GitHub scenario inventories. Local tests, GitHub CI, live host, clinical approvals, renderer execution and human release approvals are separate evidence states.
